name: io.github.luckmanqasim/sota-anchor
title: sota-anchor
description: Finds what shipped after your coding agent's training, before it rebuilds it from scratch.

environmentVariables.name: SOTA_ANCHOR_GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Raises GitHub's search limit from 10 to 30 requests a minute. Use a token with no scopes, so private repositories stay out of search results.

environmentVariables.name: SOTA_ANCHOR_BRAVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Adds general web search through Brave Search as an evidence source.
